## Foods & dishes

- [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]]: 40 recipes tagged `libyan` (ingredients without amounts, steps, nutrition).
- [[RecipeDB2]]: ≈20 recipes (amounts, steps; samples only held).
- [[WorldCuisines]]: 23 dishes, 1 Libya-only (*Bazin*); the rest shared Maghreb/Arab dishes.
- [[FmLAMA]]: 1 dish (*sharba Libiya*, 2 rows). [[World Wide Dishes]]: 1 shared dish (brik). [[ArSyra Food and Culture]]: Libya claimed.
